integrity: Exhaustive two-predicate graph-face and four discrete-Morse acyclicity verifications, plus unreduced and relative mod-two check. Reproducible standalone Python 3.9+ script and execution record included.
scientific_limitations: Finite specific graph only; no equivariant or general hypercube theorem. Some literature available only as summaries; independent external validation not performed.
title: The first cuboctahedral forest-filtration jump: thirty-two three-spheres and a thirty-six-sphere cofiber
